tagline: From incoming request to documented resolution.
overview: Resuelto is an AI-assisted IT service desk and customer support platform. Requests arrive from the customer portal, email or WhatsApp, are triaged and routed by AI, tracked against SLAs, escalated when needed and closed with root-cause documentation that feeds a knowledge base.

description: AI-assisted support with portal, email and WhatsApp intake, ticket triage, SLAs, escalation, root-cause documentation and knowledge articles.

faqs.q: Do I pay VisionX for AI?
faqs.a: No. You connect your own Claude or Gemini API key in the app's Settings, and your AI provider bills you directly for usage. VisionX does not sell AI credits.
Yes. Connect the supported WhatsApp intake to create trackable tickets with the conversation attached.
Yes. Configure response and resolution targets, business hours and escalation paths.

faqs.q: Can we support multiple customers or clients?
faqs.a: Yes. Customer isolation and role-based access support distinct customer records and responsibilities.

faqs.q: How is the knowledge base built?
faqs.a: AI drafts articles from resolved tickets and root-cause documentation. Agents review articles before publication; customers can access approved help content in the portal.
WhatsApp, email, OmniReach, Fieldora, webhooks/API and monitoring alerts. Confirm connection requirements during onboarding.
Review SLA compliance, CSAT and agent performance, with evidence of response, escalation and resolution activity.

evaluation: Confirm timezone, working week, language, client-isolation and service-level requirements. Multi-language interfaces and regional business-hour settings can be scoped for your deployment. Agents retain ownership and review AI drafts before customer communication.
